description: Fixed prompt set for Sperf/Seff bake-off runs. Ten prompts across the three user-facing capabilities.

prompts.prompt:
Below is a monthly M-Pesa summary for a small Nairobi kiosk. Write a two-sentence narration for the owner.

Income: KES 42,300 across 118 transactions.
Expenses: KES 31,800 across 47 transactions.
Top counterparty: Kimani Wholesalers (KES 12,400).
Net: +KES 10,500 vs last month +KES 6,200.

Narration:

Given this M-Pesa month, explain the movement to the owner. Cover top three counterparties, expense categories, and cashflow trend vs last month. Keep it to under 180 words.

Month: July 2026. Income KES 128,500 (312 tx). Expenses KES 96,240 (188 tx). Net +KES 32,260 vs June +KES 18,900. Top inflow: Naivas Supplies KES 34,000. Top outflow: Kimani Wholesalers KES 22,800. Expense mix: stock 62%, transport 14%, rent 12%, airtime 5%, other 7%.

Explanation:

Draft a short invoice in plain text for the following.
Seller: Mama Njeri General Store, Kiambu.
Buyer: Green Valley Restaurant.
Items: 20 kg sugar @ KES 130, 15 kg wheat flour @ KES 165, 12 packs cooking oil 1L @ KES 320.
Include subtotal and total in KES. No VAT applied.

Invoice:

Write a professional quotation from a Nairobi print shop to Riverside Academy for 500 school uniforms at KES 850 each, delivery in 21 days, 30 percent deposit required. Include quote number Q-2026-041 and validity of 14 days.

Quotation:

Draft a polite letter to a supplier requesting a 30-day extension on invoice INV-334 (KES 84,200) due to a delayed customer payment. Business: Kilimani Hardware.

Letter:

A shop owner asks: do I need to issue eTIMS invoices if my annual turnover is below 5 million KES? Answer in three short sentences, plainly, and note the source category.

Answer:

Explain Turnover Tax (TOT) in Kenya to a small shop owner in plain English: rate, who qualifies, how often filed. Under 120 words.

Answer:

At what annual turnover must a Kenyan business register for VAT, and what happens if you cross the threshold mid-year? Two short paragraphs.

Answer:

A mobile trader with no fixed premises does about KES 900,000 turnover a year. Is Turnover Tax the right regime, or should they register for something else? Answer briefly and say what you are not sure about.
